BiblicalUsage: Azmon was a town on the southern border of the promised land, named three times as the boundary was drawn from the wilderness of Zin toward the river of Egypt. It marked the edge of the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the border towns matter because the land was given with edges, and Azmon stood where the promise ended and the wilderness began.
